changes: Split view: show two pages at once, side by side on wide screens and stacked on a phone. Right-click a tab and choose Split view with this tab, or use Ctrl+K
Opera GX style side bar: Discord, Twitch, YouTube, Spotify, Reddit and Chess one tap away, opening beside your page (turn it on in Settings, or pick the Gamer look)
New Gamer look and a red Gamer tab bar color
Sleeping tabs: unused tabs can fall asleep after 5, 15 or 30 minutes to save data, and wake when you tap them
New Convert tool for length, weight, volume, speed, time and temperature
New Dice tool: coin flip, dice, a random number between two numbers, and a picker that chooses from your list
Ctrl+K now finds your open tabs and switches to them
Weather is more reliable: if the main weather service refuses or is slow, Moox switches to a backup source, and it shows the last good result instead of an error when it can
Weather: new 📍 button uses your location, and cities like "Hobart, Tasmania" now work
Weather waits longer for the service before giving up
Pinned tabs are remembered: they come back at the front next time you open Moox and load when you tap them
Right-click a tab (or press and hold on a phone) for a menu: New tab, Reload, Duplicate, Pin, Copy address, Add to favorites, Close, Close others, Close tabs to the right and Reopen closed tab
Pinned tabs shrink to just the site icon and stay at the front
Search engine setting now marks Brave as recommended, with a note about why
The greeting has a sun or moon for the time of day
The browser tab title follows the page you are on
New "Copy this page's address" in Ctrl+K, with a small pop-up message
Favorites and quick links fade in one after another
When Google shows its robot check (which can't be solved from a server), Moox offers to run the same search on DuckDuckGo or switch your search engine
The daily fact on the home page is now labelled "Fun fact"
Daily fun fact under the title (switch it off in Settings)
Gradient title, softer shadows and playful icon hover
Press ? for a list of keyboard shortcuts
One-tap Looks in Settings: Clean, Midnight, Ocean, Sunset, Forest, Candy and Grape change colors, background, tabs and tiles together
Search shortcuts: type yt cats, w moon, gh react, r topic, maps hobart, imdb, so, tw or sp followed by your words
Full screen mode hides the tab bar and address bar (Ctrl+K, then Full screen; Esc to leave)
Ctrl+K also has Duplicate this tab and Close other tabs
Fixed the colored band at the top of the home page on phones
Tab bar colors: Ocean, Sunset, Forest, Grape, Rose, Mint, Gold, Midnight, Graphite or pick your own
Tab shapes (Classic, Pills, Underline) and a color stripe per website so tabs are easy to tell apart
New switch to hide the recent sites row and Reopen session button (the Quick links switch hides quick apps)
Reopen a closed tab with Ctrl+Shift+T or from the Ctrl+K palette
Polish: smoother hover and press effects, softer shadows, glowing search box, animated menus and thinner scrollbars
Fixed the page on phones: the background now always fills the screen, even when you scroll or zoom out
Apps & games page with search, categories, a star to favorite, and a Surprise me button
Command palette: press Ctrl+K (or Cmd+K) to jump to anything
Reopen your last session's tabs, plus a row of recently visited sites on the home page
A "time left" badge shows your minutes, and reading a page now counts for a bit so guest and free time goes down correctly
Admin panel: new Apps tab to add, edit, delete, bulk import and restore the apps list
Admin panel: new Charts tab with daily users, hours browsed, sign-ups vs guests and busiest hours
Admin panel: guest controls, message banner, backups and the security log were added in earlier updates
Guest mode: try Moox for 30 minutes a day without an account
New home page: greeting, quick links, weather, calculator, timer and notes
Animated backgrounds, custom accent colours, wallpapers, fonts and corner styles
Better on phones: bottom sheets, bigger buttons, safe areas and move buttons for favorites
Warning when Moox is opened inside the Google app or another in-app browser
Version number at the bottom that updates itself, with this list
Invite links for unlock codes, a message banner from the admin, device log-out and account deletion
Accounts with a free daily time limit that resets at midnight Sydney time
One-time unlock codes for unlimited time
Admin page with live connections, users, codes and a security log
Favorites, history and settings sync to your account
